issues.t: CVT shudder, hesitation and failure
issues.sym: A shudder or judder when accelerating gently, often around 15-25 mph, hesitation or weak acceleration, whining, or the vehicle barely moving. It usually gets worse over time.
issues.why: The continuously variable transmission (CVT) in the 2013-2020 models can wear inside, letting the belt slip. Infiniti issued a service bulletin for CVT judder on the 2013 JX35 and 2014-2018 QX60, and many high-mileage owners report needing a replacement transmission.
issues.next: Have the transmission scanned for judder codes (such as P17F0) and ask an Infiniti dealer about the bulletin and any extended CVT coverage for your VIN. Change the CVT fluid on schedule with Nissan's specified fluid.

issues.t: Oil sludge and engine failure
issues.sym: White smoke at startup, tapping or knocking, the oil level dropping between changes, check engine lights, or the engine seizing.
issues.why: Owners report sludge building up inside the V6 well before 100,000 miles, sometimes even with regular oil changes. Dealers often blamed maintenance, and several owners were quoted a new engine.
issues.next: Check the oil level every few fill-ups and use the full synthetic oil the manual calls for. Keep every oil change receipt; if you hear tapping or see smoke, have the engine inspected right away.

issues.t: Timing chain rattle or tapping
issues.sym: A rattle or tapping from the front of the engine, most noticeable right after a cold start.
issues.why: Owners report noise from the timing chain area, which can come from worn chain guides or tensioner.
issues.next: Have a shop listen to it and check for timing codes. Fixing worn chain parts early can prevent engine damage.

issues.t: Erratic or high idle from a dirty throttle body
issues.sym: The idle speed bounces, sits too high, or the engine nearly stalls when you come to a stop.
issues.why: Carbon builds up in the electronic throttle body. After it is cleaned, the throttle needs an idle relearn or the idle can stay erratic.
issues.next: Have the throttle body cleaned and the idle relearn procedure done with a scan tool.

issues.t: Catalytic converters fail early
issues.sym: A check engine light with catalyst efficiency codes, a rotten-egg smell, or a failed emissions test.
issues.why: Owners report the catalytic converters wearing out sooner than expected, around 100,000 miles. Misfires or oil burning can speed it up.
issues.next: Have the codes read and fix any misfire first. Ask whether your converters are still under the long emissions warranty.

issues.t: Wheel bearing hum or growl
issues.sym: A humming or growling noise that rises with speed and may change when you turn.
issues.why: Wheel bearings and hubs wear out and are among the more-reported QX60 repairs in owner surveys.
issues.next: Have the bearings checked for play and noise. A badly worn bearing can affect steering and braking.

issues.t: Engine cooling fan stops working
issues.sym: The temperature gauge climbs in traffic or with the A/C on, or the A/C blows warmer when stopped.
issues.why: The electric radiator fan motor or its control can fail.
issues.next: Watch the temperature gauge and pull over if it runs hot. Have the fan and its fuse, relay and wiring tested.

issues.t: Rattles or squeaks from the dashboard
issues.sym: Buzzing, rattling or squeaking from the dashboard area, especially over rough roads or in cold weather.
issues.why: Dash trim and panels loosen or rub against each other with age. Owners report it as one of the more common annoyances.
issues.next: Note exactly where and when it happens so a shop can find it. Felt tape or clip repairs usually fix it.

issues.t: Sun visor breaks or won't stay up
issues.sym: The sun visor droops, will not stay in place, or breaks at its mount.
issues.why: The visor's hinge and mount wear out or crack.
issues.next: Replace the visor assembly; it is a simple repair.

issues.t: Paint defects on a new vehicle
issues.sym: Peeling, bubbling or flawed paint showing up early in ownership.
issues.why: Owners of 2014 models report factory paint defects within the first few thousand miles.
issues.next: Document it with photos and ask a dealer about warranty coverage for paint.

issues.t: Side mirror can come loose or fall off
issues.sym: The outside mirror becomes loose, shakes, or falls off.
issues.why: Owners of 2017 models report mirror housings coming apart or detaching early.
issues.next: Have the mirror reattached or replaced soon; driving without it limits your view.

issues.t: Passenger air bag may switch off with an adult seated (recall)
issues.sym: The passenger air bag OFF light stays on with an adult in the front seat, or the air bag warning light comes on.
issues.why: The occupant sensing system in the passenger seat could misread an adult as an empty seat or a child and turn the air bag off. Nissan issued several recalls to update or replace sensors and control units.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. Until it is fixed, have adults ride in the back if the OFF light stays on with someone seated.

issues.t: Hood safety catch may not hold (recall)
issues.sym: The hood is not held by the backup catch, or it can pop up while driving.
issues.why: The hood release cable could leave the secondary latch open. If the main latch let go, the hood could fly up and block your view. Nissan recalled these vehicles.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and always make sure the hood is fully closed.

issues.t: ABS software can lengthen stops on rough roads (recall)
issues.sym: When braking lightly on bumpy roads, the vehicle takes longer to stop than you expect.
issues.why: The anti-lock brake software could reduce braking pressure on rough surfaces. Nissan recalled these vehicles to reprogram it.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and get the update. Leave extra stopping room until then.

issues.t: Front brake bracket may crack (recall)
issues.sym: Grinding or scraping from a front wheel, or weaker braking.
issues.why: On some early JX35s the cast bracket that holds the front brake caliper could crack, letting the caliper move. Nissan recalled these vehicles.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the front brakes inspected.

issues.t: Fuel gauge can read fuller than it is (recall)
issues.sym: The fuel gauge stays high while the range drops, and you can run out of gas unexpectedly.
issues.why: A tube inside the fuel tank was routed wrong on some early JX35s, keeping the gauge float from dropping. Nissan recalled them.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. Until fixed, track your mileage between fill-ups.

issues.t: Front hub bolts may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking from the front wheels, or the brakes or steering feeling odd.
issues.why: Bolts that hold the front hub were not tightened properly on some vehicles, which could let the brake caliper separate. Nissan recalled them.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the hub bolts torqued.

issues.t: Lug nut may not be tightened (recall)
issues.sym: Clicking or vibration from a right-side wheel.
issues.why: One lug nut on each right-side wheel may not have been tightened at the factory. Nissan recalled affected vehicles.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. If you hear clicking from a wheel, stop and check the lug nuts.

issues.t: Hybrid system can shut down while driving (recall)
issues.sym: Warning lights come on and the vehicle loses drive power.
issues.why: Hybrid control software could shut down the hybrid system and engine. Nissan recalled QX60 Hybrids to reprogram it.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: turn on your hazard lights, hold the wheel firmly and steer to a safe spot off the road. Steering and brakes can feel much heavier when the engine or power cuts out, so press the brake harder than normal. Have it checked before you drive it again. Check your VIN for open recalls and get the update before relying on the vehicle.

issues.t: ABS pump can leak and cause a fire (recall)
issues.sym: The ABS warning light stays on for more than 10 seconds after starting, or you smell burning.
issues.why: Brake fluid can leak onto the ABS pump's circuit board and short it, which can start a fire even when parked. Nissan recalled these vehicles.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: if you smell burning or see smoke, pull over where it's safe, turn the engine off, get everyone out and well away from the car, and call 911 if there are flames. Don't drive it again until it has been repaired. Check your VIN for open recalls right away. If the ABS light stays on after startup, park outside and do not drive it until it is repaired.

issues.t: Backup camera image can stay hidden (recall)
issues.sym: No picture on the screen when you shift into Reverse.
issues.why: Camera display settings could be changed so the rear view does not show. Nissan recalled these vehicles for a software update.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. Use your mirrors and look behind you until it is fixed.

issues.t: Steering knuckle may be too weak (recall)
issues.sym: The steering wheel is off center or the vehicle pulls after hitting a curb or pothole.
issues.why: Some steering knuckles or rear axle housings were not heat-treated properly and may not be strong enough. Nissan recalled affected vehicles.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the parts inspected, especially after any hard impact.

issues.t: Adaptive headlights can aim too low (recall)
issues.sym: At highway speeds the headlights dip and light less of the road ahead.
issues.why: A lighting module setting can make the adaptive headlights point downward at certain high speeds. Nissan recalled these vehicles to reconfigure it.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. Be careful driving fast at night until it is fixed.

issues.t: Infotainment screen goes black or acts up
issues.sym: The center screen goes black, freezes or reboots, the volume changes on its own, or the wireless charger stops working.
issues.why: Infiniti issued service bulletins with software updates for infotainment problems on 2022-2023 QX60s, and owners report a range of electrical glitches.
issues.next: Ask a dealer to check for the infotainment software update for your VIN. Restarting the vehicle often clears a frozen screen for now.

issues.t: Second-row seat may be missing a bolt (recall)
issues.sym: The second-row seat shifts or rocks on its track.
issues.why: A mounting bolt may be missing from the second-row seat track, so the seat may not hold in a crash. Nissan recalled affected vehicles.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls before carrying passengers in that seat.

issues.t: Second-row seat can stick or not lock (recall)
issues.sym: The second-row seat is hard to move, gets stuck, or will not lock in place.
issues.why: The adjustable second-row seat can slide past its rear stop. Nissan recalled a small number of vehicles to replace the seat.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and make sure the seat is locked before driving.

issues.t: Driver power seat may not be secured (recall)
issues.sym: The driver's seat rocks, creaks or feels loose.
issues.why: Welds on the driver's power seat frame may not hold, so the seat may not be fully secured in a crash. Nissan recalled affected vehicles.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the seat inspected.

issues.t: Sunroof rattles or glass breaks
issues.sym: Rattling from the roof area, or in rare cases a loud bang and the sunroof glass cracking or shattering.
issues.why: Owners of 2023 models report sunroof rattles and some glass breakage with no clear cause.
issues.next: Have rattles checked under warranty. If the glass cracks, cover the opening and have it replaced before driving in rain.

issues.t: Driver air bag may not deploy properly (recall)
issues.sym: No warning in normal driving.
issues.why: Moisture can get into the driver's air bag inflator, so it may not deploy correctly in a crash. Nissan recalled affected vehicles to replace the air bag.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and get the free repair.

issues.t: Driver lap belt pretensioner may be missing a rivet (recall)
issues.sym: No warning in normal driving.
issues.why: A rivet may be missing from the driver's lap belt pretensioner, so the belt may not hold properly in a crash. Nissan recalled affected vehicles.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and get it repaired promptly.
